source: Existing IID odd-level cyclotomic PSP samples with integer-embedded secrets, not a polynomial-evaluation oracle.

local_results.public_compiler: Known GF3 RREF/SUM shears measure rank syndromes and retain m-rank correlated registers; every native syndrome is retained with probability3^-rank.
local_results.residual: Exact public Q_l(z)=(C_l(x+Vz)-C_l(x))/3; unknown phase is sum_l s_l*Q_l(z). Top secret digit is lost after measurement.
local_results.level3: Classical cubic F3 component functions; leading cubic signature depends only on low labels and kernel chart, not higher digits or syndrome.
local_results.conditional_sum: Three packets with matched leading component tensors cancel cubic terms for all shifts. This is verified algebra, not a full physical three-packet source workflow.
local_results.matching: Literal matching of two fresh low matrices to the first costs3^(-2*n*m). This is not an optimal tensor-alignment lower bound.
local_results.higher_levels: L5 retains modulus9 phases with a nonzero fourth mixed additive derivative. Fixed classical cubic receiver transfer is blocked, not all receivers.
local_results.literature_scope: Boolean same-function phase-learning and same-state qudit stabilizer-learning promises are not automatically supplied by random native packets.

proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-SOURCE: Charge acquisition of intermediate odd-level samples from the original even-level CCP, then prove matching/alignment probability with higher-label conditioning, syndrome costs and correlations explicit.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-RECEIVER: Recover unknown secret coordinates from varying known native phase functions without free evaluations of their unknown scalar combination.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-COMPLEXITY: Bound growing-level phase depth, all consumed packets, confidence amplification and complete secret-digit recursion.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-COPIES: Distinguish three supplied quantum inputs from three descriptors; no cloning or implicit identical-state promise.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-CLASSICAL: Compare classical inference from the legal measurement records, not an illegal unknown-phase table.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-REVIEW: Independent mathematical review and novelty search before admitting an algorithm candidate.

falsifiers: A supposedly classical cubic packet has a nonzero fourth derivative or incorrect phase modulus.
Matched cubic cancellation is used despite unequal component signatures or uncharged source conditioning.
Retained registers are counted as independent phase samples despite entanglement and correlations.
A fixed-level decoder discards secret digits or requires same-state copies unavailable under the source law.
The full growing-parameter construction remains quasi-polynomial or is matched by a legal classical/known quantum baseline.
next_experiment: Analyze public tensor alignment and secret-linear receiver structure before expanding low-level numerical benchmarks.
